description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: With Lindsey Graham Gone, Ukraine Loses an Ally in Trump’s Ear
changes.summary: The South Carolina Republican was Ukraine’s most influential champion inside President Trump’s mostly “America First” political orbit.

changes.title: A Robot Army Remakes Ground Warfare in Ukraine
changes.summary: They began as supply mules. Now ground robots evacuate the wounded, hold trenches and even do the killing.

changes.title: A Look at Lindsey Graham’s Political Legacy and Impact
changes.summary: Meet the Press Moderator Kristen Welker joins TODAY to discuss Sen. Lindsey Graham’s vast political legacy and share what he was like off camera. She also breaks down how his death impacts United States foreign policy with the wars in Iran and Ukraine.

changes.title: The Next Phase in Ukraine’s War With Russia: The Battle for Minds
changes.summary: Ukrainians, already drone innovators, are turning their focus to psychological operations aimed at undercutting Russian support for the war.

changes.title: Ukraine's prime minister resigns; Zelenskyy shifts several government roles
changes.summary: Ukrainian Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko has stepped down as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced fresh changes to Ukraine's government.

changes.title: Trump Sought an Iran War Exit. Putin Pushed On in Ukraine. Now Both Are Stuck.
changes.summary: The Iran and Ukraine wars underline the common limits of military force in achieving political ends, but also the differences between a dug-in Russian president and a vacillating American one.

changes.title: Graham makes final remarks in Ukraine a day before this death
changes.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and made public remarks during a trip to Kyiv just one day before his death. Graham said he was focused on advancing legislation aimed at imposing sanctions on Russian oil.

changes.title: Zelensky Announces Leadership Shuffle as War Turns in Ukraine’s Favor
changes.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine’s prime minister, Yuliia Svyrydenko, would step down amid a broader shake-up in Ukraine’s senior leadership.
